about: Real traffic between two qrdrop peers over Trystero 0.25.4, one run per strategy, written by scripts/record-trystero.mjs --live (the public relays answered). relay[] is every WebSocket message in order, from each peer's side; channel[] is every data-channel message. t_ms is milliseconds since the run started. Messages over 256 bytes are kept as head (the first 160 bytes), length and sha256. Peer connections were bound to 127.0.0.1 with no ICE servers, so every candidate is a loopback one.
